data.description:
Add sentinel lockout to read-config.sh: after the dso.workflow shim (S1), reject legacy key reads when the migration sentinel exists.

## Testing Mode: GREEN (makes Task 053d-dd3b-7a86-4e92 RED tests pass)

## File to Modify
plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh

## Placement
After the dso.workflow shim block inserted by S1 (which handles "dso.workflow" key and exits 0):
Insert a new block BEFORE the config file resolution (before the "Resolve config file when not specified" comment).

## Implementation Block to Insert
```bash
# Sentinel lockout for legacy keys — after migration, any read of a legacy key fails fast.
# IMPORTANT: Do NOT commit .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated until after S6 legacy-reference
# cleanup is merged. The sentinel file should be gitignored locally during the S3→S6 window.
_legacy_keys="merge.strategy enforcement.strategy worktree.isolation_enabled attribution.enabled"
if printf '%s\n' $_legacy_keys | grep -qx "$key" 2>/dev/null; then
    _sentinel_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    if [[ -n "$_sentinel_root" && -f "$_sentinel_root/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated" ]]; then
        echo "DSO: '$key' is a legacy config key that has been disabled after migration. To restore, run: git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi
```

## Notes
- The four legacy keys are: merge.strategy, enforcement.strategy, worktree.isolation_enabled, attribution.enabled
- The dso.workflow shim (S1) exits 0 before reaching this block for dso.workflow reads — no interference
- The sentinel file path: <git-root>/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated
- Use printf + grep -x (exact match) to prevent partial key matches

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD1: after sentinel exists, read-config.sh <legacy-key> exits non-zero with recovery message
- DD2: read-config.sh dso.workflow unaffected by sentinel (shim exits 0 before this block runs)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 5 tests from Task 053d-dd3b-7a86-4e92 pass (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- [ ] No reference to enforcement.strategy or merge.strategy added outside the lockout block
- [ ] The four legacy keys are enumerated in the _legacy_keys variable
  Verify: grep -q 'merge\.strategy.*enforcement\.strategy' plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
